name: g1-contract-assertions
command:
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'import json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260731T064607Z/g1")
summary=json.loads((root/"range-api-summary.json").read_text())
assert summary["passed"] is True and not summary["errors"]
assert summary["config"]=={"num_keys":3,"num_layers":4,"object_size":16384,"page_size":4096,"run_negative":True,"total_size":49152}
assert summary["source_checksum"]==summary["destination_checksum_after"] and summary["source_checksum"]!=summary["destination_checksum_before"]
assert all(case["passed"] for case in summary["cases"]) and all(item["passed"] for item in summary["cleanup"])
names={case["name"] for case in summary["cases"]}
required={"positive_nonzero_object_offset","positive_byte_compare","negative_no_put_session","negative_no_get_session","negative_duplicate_put_start","negative_offset_overflow","negative_put_arity_mismatch","negative_ranged_put_after_end","negative_ranged_get_after_end","negative_get_arity_mismatch","negative_revoke_not_gettable"}
assert required<=names,required-names
positive=[call for call in summary["api_calls"] if call["operation"] in {"batch_put_from_multi_buffer_ranges","batch_get_into_multi_buffer_ranges"} and call["phase"]=="positive"]
assert len(positive)==8,len(positive)
assert any(any(any(offset>0 for offset in row) for row in call["object_offsets"]) for call in positive)
for call in positive:
    assert len(call["result"])==3
    for result,sizes in zip(call["result"],call["sizes"],strict=True):
        assert result==sum(sizes)==4096,(result,sizes)
for metric_file in ("preflight.metrics","post-driver.metrics"):
    text=(root/metric_file).read_text()
    for name in ("master_key_count","master_allocated_bytes","master_active_clients"):
        match=re.search(rf"^{name} ([0-9.eE+-]+)$",text,re.M); assert match and float(match.group(1))==0,(metric_file,name)
sha=(root/"driver-sha256.txt").read_text().splitlines(); assert len(sha)==2 and sha[0].split("=",1)[1]==sha[1].split("=",1)[1]
assert "| OK" in (root/"npu-after-g1.txt").read_text()
print(json.dumps({"validated":True,"keys":3,"layers":4,"page_size":4096,"api_calls":len(summary["api_calls"]),"cases":len(summary["cases"]),"negative_cases":len([name for name in names if name.startswith("negative_")]),"nonzero_offsets":True,"bytes_equal":True,"cleanup":True,"post_driver_empty":True},sort_keys=True,indent=2))'
